business_scenario: Upload a well-formed product master and transaction file
precondition: App is running, no files loaded
steps: 1. Select Upload 2 Files. 2. Upload valid product master. 3. Upload valid transaction CSV. 4. Click Run Full Analysis.
expected_result: Analysis completes and all dashboard pages populate with data.

business_scenario: Upload with a missing required column
steps: 1. Upload a transaction CSV missing the SKU column. 2. Click Run Full Analysis.
expected_result: A user-friendly error names the missing/unusable field; no stack trace is shown.

business_scenario: Upload an empty transaction file
steps: 1. Upload a 0-row transaction CSV. 2. Click Run Full Analysis.
expected_result: App reports no usable rows rather than crashing.

business_scenario: Upload a non-CSV/XLSX file
steps: 1. Rename a .png to .csv and upload it. 2. Click Run Full Analysis.
expected_result: App rejects the file with a clear message.

business_scenario: Product-master reconciliation with valid SKUs
steps: 1. Run analysis. 2. Open Data Validation & Privacy Checks.
expected_result: Join coverage % and unmatched-SKU count are shown and consistent with input row counts.

business_scenario: Duplicate SKU rows in product master
precondition: Product master with 2 rows sharing the same SKU
steps: 1. Upload. 2. Run analysis.
expected_result: Duplicate SKU count is reported in validation_summary; no silent row loss.

business_scenario: Unmatched transaction rows (SKU not in product master)
precondition: Transactions include a SKU absent from the product master
steps: 1. Upload. 2. Run analysis.
expected_result: Unmatched transaction row count is reported; those rows are not silently dropped from totals.

business_scenario: KPI calculation matches formula on Marketplace Performance page
steps: 1. Open Marketplace Performance. 2. Read Average Fee % of Gross KPI card.
expected_result: Displayed value equals the mean of avg_fee_pct_of_gross in the filtered marketplace_channel_performance rows.

business_scenario: Marketplace filter narrows product results
steps: 1. Open Product, Brand & Category Intelligence. 2. Filter to a single marketplace.
expected_result: Only rows for that marketplace remain in the table and charts.

business_scenario: Period selector on Performance Drivers page
precondition: Demo data loaded (12-month dataset, 12 distinct transaction months)
steps: 1. Open Performance Drivers & Root Cause. 2. Read the previous/current period caption.
expected_result: Caption shows the two most recent distinct transaction months present in the dataset.

business_scenario: Product filter narrows product results
steps: 1. Open Product, Brand & Category Intelligence. 2. Filter to a single product.
expected_result: Table and charts show only that product's rows.

business_scenario: Dashboard totals reconcile to underlying mart
steps: 1. Open Marketplace Performance. 2. Note the Marketplaces KPI card value. 3. Count distinct marketplace values in marketplace_channel_performance.csv.
expected_result: The two numbers match.

business_scenario: Drill-down from marketplace to product scatter
steps: 1. Open Marketplace Performance. 2. View the Sales Index vs Margin Risk scatter chart.
expected_result: Chart renders with one point per product-marketplace pair, hover shows public_product_id (never a real SKU).

business_scenario: Recommendation rule triggers with visible reason
steps: 1. Open Inventory, Restock & Action Review. 2. Inspect a High-priority row.
expected_result: recommended_action, action_priority, and a non-empty action_reason are all shown.

business_scenario: Restock Review rule fires correctly
precondition: units_index >= 50 and inventory_band is low for a product
steps: 1. Run analysis with such a product present.
expected_result: recommended_action == 'Restock Review' for that product.

business_scenario: Slow Mover Review rule fires correctly
precondition: units_index < 10 and inventory_band is high for a product
steps: 1. Run analysis with such a product present.
expected_result: recommended_action == 'Slow Mover Review' for that product.

business_scenario: Margin Risk Review rule fires correctly
steps: 1. Run analysis with such a product present.
expected_result: recommended_action == 'Margin Risk Review'.

business_scenario: Revenue Quality Score band displays correctly
steps: 1. Open Fees, Refunds & Revenue Quality. 2. Inspect revenue_quality_band values.
expected_result: Bands match shared/profitability.py:revenue_quality_band thresholds.

business_scenario: Privacy scan blocks unsafe output
precondition: A crafted output containing an ASIN-shaped value
steps: 1. Run scan_public_outputs against it.
expected_result: is_safe is False and content_hit_count > 0.

business_scenario: Full-frame privacy scan on real demo outputs
steps: 1. Run python python/run_privacy_scan.py.
expected_result: content_hit_count == 0 and is_safe == true.

business_scenario: Safe export ZIP excludes private files
steps: 1. Open Demo & Export Center. 2. Download the export ZIP. 3. Inspect its contents.
expected_result: ZIP contains only public CSVs; no private_raw or private_mapping files.

business_scenario: Marketplace-channel mapping status is honestly reported
steps: 1. Open Data Validation & Privacy Checks. 2. Find the channel mapping status row.
expected_result: Row reads 'Unavailable' with a note explaining incomplete mapping keys.

business_scenario: Demo mode loads without any file upload
precondition: App freshly started, demo public CSVs present on disk
steps: 1. Select Sample Demo. 2. Click Launch Sample Demo Dashboard.
expected_result: All dashboard pages populate without requiring any upload; a 'Sample Demo' mode badge is visible.

business_scenario: Validation summary displays PASS/WARN/FAIL correctly
steps: 1. Open Data Validation & Privacy Checks.
expected_result: Every row shows one of PASS, WARN, or FAIL; no other status value appears.

business_scenario: Root-cause page shows deterministic narrative
steps: 1. Open Performance Drivers & Root Cause. 2. Select a metric. 3. Read the narrative box.
expected_result: Narrative sentence names a metric, a direction, a magnitude, and a top contributor, using non-causal language.

business_scenario: Root-cause page states plainly when there is no driver
precondition: A dataset with only one distinct transaction_month
steps: 1. Open Performance Drivers & Root Cause.
expected_result: Page shows an explicit 'insufficient periods' message; no comparison is fabricated.

business_scenario: Root-cause page ranks marketplace contributors correctly
steps: 1. Open Performance Drivers & Root Cause. 2. Select Sales Index. 3. Read the marketplace contribution chart/table.
expected_result: Marketplaces are ranked by absolute variance magnitude, largest first.

business_scenario: Root-cause page ranks product contributors correctly
steps: 1. Open Performance Drivers & Root Cause. 2. Select Revenue Quality Score. 3. Read the top-25 product contributor table.
expected_result: Products are ranked by absolute variance magnitude, largest first, showing only public_product_id.

business_scenario: All 9 dashboard pages are reachable from the sidebar
steps: 1. Open the sidebar. 2. Confirm each of the 9 page links is present.
expected_result: Executive Overview, Marketplace Performance, Product/Brand/Category Intelligence, Fees/Refunds/Revenue Quality, Profitability & Margin Intelligence, Inventory/Restock/Action Review, Data Validation & Privacy Checks, Demo & Export Center, and Performance Drivers & Root Cause all appear.

business_scenario: Estimated profitability uses explicit estimate labels
steps: 1. Open Profitability & Margin Intelligence and About/Methodology pages. 2. Review metric labels.
expected_result: The metric is labeled 'Estimated Profitability Index' and described as a profitability signal.

business_scenario: Rejected rows are quarantined, not silently dropped
precondition: A transaction file with one row missing a required field
steps: 1. Upload. 2. Run analysis. 3. Open Data Validation & Privacy Checks.
expected_result: A quarantine/rejected-row count is shown separately from the accepted-row count.

business_scenario: Contract validation rejects a file with the wrong required field types
precondition: Product master with a non-numeric value in a numeric-required column
steps: 1. Upload. 2. Run analysis.
expected_result: Contract validation flags the field with a clear error_code/reason; app does not crash.

business_scenario: KPI catalog matches implementation for a sample of 3 KPIs
steps: 1. Pick Margin Risk Score, Revenue Quality Score, Sales Index. 2. Compare documented formula to shared/profitability.py and shared/metrics.py.
expected_result: Formulas match exactly.
